title: SLM / Logs
description: Everything the app logged, read out of GreptimeDB's otel_logs table over SQL. Filter by severity and module; click a trace_id to open the trace the line was emitted inside.

list.name: minSeverity
list.label: Min severity
list.description: OTel severity numbers: DEBUG 5, INFO 9, WARN 13, ERROR 17, FATAL 21.
list.query: Debug and above : 5,Info and above : 9,Warnings and errors : 13,Errors only : 17

list.name: module
list.label: Module
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT json_get_string(log_attributes, '$."slm.module.name"') AS module FROM otel_logs WHERE json_get_string(log_attributes, '$."slm.module.name"') IS NOT NULL ORDER BY module

panels.title: Log volume by severity
panels.description: Every record, regardless of the filters below: a quiet app and a filter that matches nothing look the same in the table but not here.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('minute', timestamp) AS time, severity_text AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY time, severity_text ORDER BY time

SELECT timestamp AS "time", severity_text AS "severity", json_get_string(log_attributes, '$."slm.module.name"') AS "module", body AS "message", trace_id FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND severity_number >= $minSeverity AND coalesce(json_get_string(log_attributes, '$."slm.module.name"'), '') LIKE '$module' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1000
